Implement the module described by the complete specification.

Specification:
extend:
  description: >
    Combinational RV32I immediate extension unit. Reconstructs the 32-bit
    immediate from instruction bits [31:7] according to ImmSrcD, for the five base
    RV32I formats (I, S, B, J, U), with correct sign extension and the
    RISC-V fragmented bit orderings.
  tech_node: ASAP7 / SkyWater 130HD (course flow)
  clock_period: combinational (no clock)
  ports:
    - {name: InstrD,  direction: input,  type: "logic [31:7]", description: "Instruction bits 31:7 (opcode not needed for immediates)"}
    - {name: ImmSrcD, direction: input,  type: "logic [2:0]",  description: Selects the immediate format}
    - {name: ImmExtD, direction: output, type: "logic [31:0]", description: Reconstructed 32-bit immediate}
  module_signature: |
    module extend (
        input  logic [31:7] InstrD,
        input  logic [2:0]  ImmSrcD,
        output logic [31:0] ImmExtD
    );
  behavior:
    formats: |
      ImmSrcD  Format  Use
      000      I-type  ALU-immediate, loads, JALR
      001      S-type  stores
      010      B-type  conditional branches
      011      J-type  JAL
      100      U-type  LUI, AUIPC
      (101/110/111 unused; output unspecified, not graded)
    construction: |
      I: {{20{InstrD[31]}}, InstrD[31:20]}
      S: {{20{InstrD[31]}}, InstrD[31:25], InstrD[11:7]}
      B: {{20{InstrD[31]}}, InstrD[7], InstrD[30:25], InstrD[11:8], 1'b0}
      J: {{12{InstrD[31]}}, InstrD[19:12], InstrD[20], InstrD[30:21], 1'b0}
      U: {InstrD[31:12], 12'b0}
    notes: >
      B- and J-type immediates are sign-extended and have an implicit 1'b0 in bit 0
      (2-byte aligned). Note B bit 11 comes from InstrD[7]; J bit 11 from InstrD[20].
    timing: >
      Purely combinational; no clocked state; no latches for valid ImmSrcD.
      Synthesizable SystemVerilog. All immediates are 32 bits (XLEN=32).
    out_of_scope: >
      No RV64, atomics immediates, compressed, custom formats, or privileged instrs.
  sample_usage:
    description: Representative immediates including negative and fragmented fields.
    cases:
      - {ImmSrcD: "000", InstrD_31_20: "0xFFF", ImmExtD: "0xFFFFFFFF", note: "I-type -1"}
      - {ImmSrcD: "100", InstrD_31_12: "0xABCDE", ImmExtD: "0xABCDE000", note: "U-type"}
      - {ImmSrcD: "010", desc: "B-type +8 (bits set so imm=8)", ImmExtD: "0x00000008"}
      - {ImmSrcD: "010", desc: "B-type -4",                     ImmExtD: "0xFFFFFFFC"}
